trigger: runtime-resolution-intake produced enough parent, launch, shim, or fleet-state evidence to compare runtime identity

steps.action: Require an explicit requested surface. Unknown remains unresolved.
Normalize parent command identity by runtime family and directory; .ps1 versus .cmd launch shims in the same npm prefix may represent the same native package family.
Resolve wrapperKind, wrapper path, target command path, and target platform for the effective launch.
For native-windows requests, fail as shim-shadowing-native when the effective launch uses agentswitchboard-wsl-shim or targets wsl-ubuntu.
Fail as parent-child-divergence when parent and launch runtime families differ without a declared WSL transition.
Fail as state-command-drift when fleet state identifies a different command family than the effective launch after normalization.
Pass native-consistent only when native-windows was requested and the effective target is Windows native/npm OpenCode.
Pass declared-wsl-consistent only when wsl-ubuntu was explicitly requested and the effective target is the registered WSL OpenCode surface.
Use unresolved-runtime-identity for missing effective launch identity, missing wrapper target, unknown requested surface, or incomplete PATH evidence.
Do not mutate the machine. Route native repair, WSL repair, or end-to-end proof to the owning existing surface named in runtime-resolution.registry.json.

proofCeiling: Deterministic diagnosis from supplied evidence only.
